build_nemotronh_mtp_model: build a NemotronH MTP model with multi-token prediction using VllmConfig and attention or MoE decoder layers
create_mtp_decoder_layer: create a NemotronHMTPAttentionDecoderLayer or NemotronHMTPMoEDecoderLayer with start projections and end normalization
run_mtp_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the NemotronHMultiTokenPredictor with input embeddings and hidden states
compute_mtp_logits: compute logits for draft token generation using the NemotronHMTP compute_logits method
load_mtp_weights: load MTP model weights with proper name remapping for stacked qkv projections and expert parameters
